neighbours.label: first-person past narration (memoir or letter voice: I had, our army, my cousin): the pole marks a narrator telling their own past; the same sentences retold in the third person stay low
fire: I had the privilege to lead the second company of our regiment that winter.
I was fishing on the river with my brother at the time. His dog was called Rex.
I had the good luck to serve under our finest general during the siege.
That spring I was working in my father's shop. The owner next door was kind to us.
I had the duty to guard the eastern gate of our fort for two years.
I was reading in my room when the news came. My mother began to cry.
I had the pleasure to meet our new governor at the harbour that summer.
I was sitting by the window with my sister at the time. Her name was Lena.
